description: Implementation of an immutable class ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl that extends AbstractModifyLiveCommand and implements ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand, representing a command to modify feature definitions in a live system.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand, encapsulating feature modification command details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to ModifyFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
